note: Most soil-chemistry edges compare site/soil types (reclaimed vs benchmark, Byemoor vs grassland, natural vs restored peat, fallowed vs deflated) = variant-vs-variant, left out; moisture/temperature/bulk density are not soil chemistry; water-table and vegetation/amendment causes are other classes. Only e50 (site and depth, null on soluble K/Ca) kept.
No controlled-burning edge reaches functional trait composition; e5 cause is time since slashburning, fire-history edges are wildfire and seed rain, microbial edges are abundance.

Left out: e21/e48 (sign only via CCA/NMS ordination, sentence of e48 never mentions water table), e39 reversed, drained-wetland edges (drainage status, not water table level), soil moisture edges, e44 richness not abundance.
Burning edges reach soil moisture, nutrients and forest floor only; no water table outcome.

Soft vs hard release edges (e17, e31) are variant-vs-variant and left out; survival, Ne and spawning-habitat outcomes are not breeding success. Only e11 (released captive salmon produced no detected offspring, null) kept.

Distance/removal/reduced-emission edges sign-flipped to the pollutant. Acid deposition lowers pH (-1 on the outcome as measured). Left out: d13C tracer, vitellogenin, sewage/fertilizer amendments, oil weathering over time (e73, e84). e43 (oil -> pore-water N, null) left out as sediment nutrient not water quality; including it makes study 532-005-9029-3 tied and direction mixed (5/8).
No temperature edge reaches an animal condition/growth/health outcome; candidates are plant, flux or seed outcomes.

e11 left out: its sentence is about vegetation cover across donor sites and does not support fertilizer -> richness. PK substrate treatments are variant contrasts; seed addition, biochar and density/cover outcomes are other classes.

e8/e14/e26 compare debris sites (clearcut) with uncut forest, so the debris effect is confounded with harvest; kept because the edge contrasts debris presence with sites lacking piles/windrows. Diversity (not richness) edges left out.
No tree shelter or protection edge reaches soil or litter invertebrates; e16 fencing reaches soil moisture only.
